title: Helm, KEDA and autoscaling

acceptance_gates.description: Helm charts lint and render cleanly and pass Kubernetes policy validation.
KEDA scales Temporal Activity worker pools per queue, with scale-to-zero only on queues where v1.2 permits it.
Rollback is demonstrated in staging for both API and worker deployments.
